basic_details.job_title: IIT Roorkee JRF Recruitment 2026 – Apply by Email for 1 Junior Research Fellow Post
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Roorkee has announced the IIT Roorkee JRF Recruitment 2026 for 1 Junior Research Fellow post in the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering. Candidates with B.E./B.Tech in ECE or Engineering Physics, or an equivalent qualification, can apply by email. The interview is scheduled for 30 October 2026.

qualification.details: Applicants must possess B.E./B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) or Engineering Physics, or an equivalent qualification. | The current notification does not explicitly specify a GATE requirement, minimum percentage, CGPA, or maximum age limit. Candidates should verify their eligibility against the official notice before applying. | The candidate is expected to have the following knowledge and skills: | Good knowledge of device physics. Good knowledge of Technology Computer-Aided Design (TCAD) tools. Strong programming skills in C, C++, Python, MATLAB, Simulink or similar tools.

salary_details.initial appointment: 1 year or until the end of the project
salary_details.details: The selected candidate will receive Rs. 37,000 per month plus House Rent Allowance (HRA), as per institute rules.

selection_process: The recruitment notice provides for an interview. Candidates must ensure that they meet the eligibility requirements before appearing.
Applicants must bring original educational qualifications and experience certificates for verification at the interview.
Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates when qualifications and experience are equal. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.
how_to_apply: Eligible candidates can submit their applications to the Principal Investigator's office through email by following these steps:
Read the official IIT Roorkee JRF recruitment notification carefully.
Prepare an application on plain paper with a detailed curriculum vitae (CV).
Include educational qualifications and certificates in chronological order.
Provide details of relevant research, industrial or other experience, where applicable.
Attach attested copies of educational and experience certificates.
Use the email subject: "Application for the post of JRF in a project entitled A novel power-on pilot IC for ultra-low power wireless IoT devices".
Send the application and documents to [email protected].
Keep a copy of the submitted email and documents for reference.
Bring original certificates to the interview for verification.
Note: The notice does not prescribe a separate online application portal or application fee.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee JRF Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The research project is titled "A novel power-on pilot IC for ultra-low power wireless IoT devices". The Principal Investigator is Prof. Sudeb Dasgupta, and the position is under the supervision of Co-PI Prof. Anand Bulusu.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee JRF Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess B.E./B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) or Engineering Physics, or an equivalent qualification. The current notification does not explicitly specify a GATE requirement, minimum percentage, CGPA, or maximum age limit. Candidates should verify their eligibility against the official notice before applying. The candidate is expected to have the following knowledge and skills: Good knowledge of device physics. Good knowledge of Technology Computer-Aided Design (TCAD) tools. Strong programming skills in C, C++, Python, MATLAB, Simulink or similar tools.

content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive Rs. 37,000 per month plus House Rent Allowance (HRA), as per institute rules.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Roorkee JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 Junior Research Fellow vacancy, in the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering at IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is required for the IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a B.E/B.Tech in ECE or Engineering Physics, or equivalent. Candidates are also expected to have good knowledge of device physics and TCAD tools, and strong programming skills in C/C++/Python/MATLAB/Simulink etc.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary of the IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow gets Rs. 37,000 plus HRA, with the HRA paid as per institute rules.

faq.question: Q4. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 37,000 pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice gives the pay as Rs. 37,000 + HRA, with the HRA paid as per IIT Roorkee institute rules.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the IIT Roorkee JRF post?
faq.answer: Email your application to [email protected]. Include a plain-paper application with a detailed CV, details of your experience, and attested copies of your degree/certificate and experience certificate.

faq.question: Q6. What subject line should I use in the email?
faq.answer: Use this subject line: "Application for the post of JRF in a project entitled (project name)". The project is "A novel power-on pilot IC for ultra-low power wireless IoT devices".

faq.question: Q7. When and where is the IIT Roorkee JRF interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 30 October 2026, from 3 pm to 4 pm, in the Conference Room, ECE, IIT Roorkee. Bring your original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) for verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IIT Roorkee JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a project position for a MeitY-sponsored project under the C2S programme (Tier-I). It lasts initially for one year (or until the end of the project).

faq.question: Q9. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Who can apply, and do any candidates get preference?
faq.answer: Only Indian nationals can apply. SC/ST candidates get preference when qualifications and experience are equal.
